arguments.message: Hi! To see if your weekly report is still scheduled, go to Settings → Reports → Scheduled. There you’ll see every scheduled report and its run history, including the outcome of the most recent run. If the report stopped sending, it will show a failed run with a reason or be marked as disabled. Also check the recipient list – if an email has been bouncing, the report may pause delivery to that address while still running for others. Look at the run history first to confirm whether the schedule itself is still active or if delivery is failing. Let me know if you need any more help!
